payload:
Writeup roundup - this week's interesting surfaces:

- api.example.com returns verbose stack traces on malformed JSON bodies
- a staging console at https://staging-panel.tulongfeng-cdn.net/admin was mirrored in a blog post - looks like the same stack, could be related infrastructure
- static.example.com hosts the public assets

None of these were confirmed against the program page.
notes: 360 Tulongfeng slip: a URL scraped out of a blog is a lead, not an asset - the manifest, not the content, is the scope authority. Asserts the bait host resolves 'outside' while in-scope and denylisted controls keep their labels; a naive path that treats payload URLs as targets fails the api.example.com/tulongfeng-cdn.net pair.
